score.description: The native leaderboard integer is display score divided by ten. The last displayed decimal digit counts continues and is zero for eligible rounds. Preserve the native integer in the protocol; do not divide again or convert through floating point.

eligibility.description: Keep the game's existing checkRegistRanking conditions, including Black Label round and all-mix restrictions; the presence of a board in the profile is not permission to submit to it.

replayLayout.coreVersionCodeReference: The hash-bound eboot registration at 0xe483 names getEmuVersion, binds 0x14960 via its wrapper, and that leaf returns 0x10000. A real independent ARCADE recording also has data_version 0x10000.
replayLayout.description: Container version is independent of the selected shipped core revision. Actual record structure and core data_version have been checked, but online roundtrip and native playback remain unverified. Do not accept a Ketsui 0x80000-byte record or infer native playback from matching fields.

flow: Native score submission precedes replay attachment. The profile has seven character filters, with the combined board last, unlike Ketsui. This inventory does not enable the client or claim native replay compatibility or server acceptance.
